description: Section 4 cutoff 0/1 hosted A/B. All 30 child sample objects and all 15 hosted paired comparisons retained; invalid observations are not removed.

extraction.aggregate_summary_limitation: Single-protocol download was flat. Top-level observed-samples.json and paired-comparisons.json were empty, but run_1 contained the full raw observations and hosted-calculated intervals.
extraction.omitted: Full 500ms process series and repeated backend startup logs remain in the original artifact. No project code, build, test, or script was executed locally.

dispatch.skip_protocols: http2 http3 grpcs wss tcp-tls udp udp-dtls

diagnostics.backend_logs: All 30 contain only startup banners/listener addresses
